summary: [MOCK] Probable root cause: database connection pool exhaustion in checkout-service. No evidence of a security attack.

findings.title: Probable root cause: DB connection pool exhaustion
findings.description: All 50 pooled connections were held while 187 requests waited, causing acquisition timeouts and 503s. Root cause is suspected, not confirmed; why connections were held (slow queries vs. leak) is not yet established.

findings.title: No security indicators found
findings.description: Request volume and client distribution were within normal range; no authentication anomalies or suspicious payloads in the analysed logs.

evidence.content: HikariPool-1 - Connection is not available ... (total=50, active=50, idle=0, waiting=187)

evidence.relevance: Slow queries hold connections longer, supporting exhaustion hypothesis.

root_cause.description: Database connection pool exhaustion in checkout-service

alternative_hypotheses.description: Connection leak introduced by recent code change

security_analysis.summary: No security attack supported by available data.
